fidelity: frozen upstream algorithm with explicit tested semantic repairs; not bitwise source loss parity
semantic_repairs: answer-only teacher targets, exclude -100 labels from indexing and CE
lr_search: no test-based tuning; configured source recipe, additional trials separate
prompt: raw question-space-answer, no chat template; source-paper prompt not certified identical
native_compatibility: full parameter update except native KLUE gated FFN neuron mask
loss_precision: BF16 backbone, FP32 returned logits/loss matching Accelerate output conversion
batching: actual padded batch, not serial per-example gradient averaging
